default.shell:
ret="pass"
  for u in $(/usr/bin/dscl . list /users shell | /usr/bin/egrep -v '(^_)|(root)|(/usr/bin/false)' | /usr/bin/awk '{print $1}'); do
    sshCheck=$(/usr/bin/sudo -u $u /usr/bin/ssh -tt -G . | /usr/bin/grep -i -c '^[[:space:]]*KexAlgorithms[[:space:]]*.*mlkem768x25519-sha256')
    if [[ "$sshCheck" == "0" ]]; then
      ret="fail"
      break
    fi
done
echo $ret

discussion:
If SSH is used then it _MUST_ be configured for a hybrid Post Quantum Cryptographic (PQC) key exchange.

NOTE: On macOS 15.2 and higher the SSH configuration can be reset to the macOS default by running /usr/libexec/reset-ssh-configuration.

steps.shell:
if [ -f /etc/ssh/crypto.conf ] && /usr/bin/grep -q "Include /etc/ssh/crypto.conf" /etc/ssh/ssh_config.d/100-macos.conf 2>/dev/null; then
  /bin/ln -fs /etc/ssh/crypto/fips.conf /etc/ssh/crypto.conf
fi
include_dir=$(/usr/bin/awk '/^Include/ {print $2}' /etc/ssh/ssh_config | /usr/bin/tr -d '*')

for u in $(/usr/bin/dscl . list /users shell | /usr/bin/egrep -v '(^_)|(root)|(/usr/bin/false)' | /usr/bin/awk '{print $1}'); do
  config=$(/usr/bin/sudo -u $u /usr/bin/ssh -tt -Gv . 2>&1)
  currentkex=$(echo "$config" | /usr/bin/awk 'tolower($0) ~ /kexalgorithms/{print $2}')
  configfiles=$(echo "$config" | /usr/bin/awk '/Reading configuration data/ {print $NF}'| /usr/bin/tr -d '\r')
  configarray=( ${(f)configfiles} )
  if ! echo $config | /usr/bin/grep -q -i "mlkem768x25519-sha256" ; then
    for c in $configarray; do
      if [[ "$c" == "/etc/ssh/crypto.conf" ]]; then
        continue
      fi

      if /usr/bin/grep -qEi '^[[:space:]]*KexAlgorithms[[:space:]]' "$c"; then
        /usr/bin/sed -i '' '/^[[:space:]]*KexAlgorithms[[:space:]]/I s/$/,mlkem768x25519-sha256/' "$c"
        break
      fi
      if [[ "$c" =~ ".ssh/config" ]]; then
        if /usr/bin/grep -qEi '^[[:space:]]*KexAlgorithms[[:space:]]*mlkem768x25519-sha256' "$c" 2> /dev/null; then
          old_file=$(cat ~$u/.ssh/config)
          echo "kexalgorithms $currentkex,mlkem768x25519-sha256" > ~$u/.ssh/config
          echo "$old_file" >> ~$u/.ssh/config
        fi
      fi
    done
  fi
done
